lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Напоминания об обновлении и полной синхронизации
value.meaning: Separate advisory ages for known uninstalled update, successful update check and complete sync of the current online project.
value.value_origin: Validated manifest/ready APK and canonical ProjectSyncState -> MaintenanceReminders.read -> AppUpdateManager foreground/current-project guard -> warning or ready-install dialog.
value.units: Wall-clock elapsed milliseconds; strict >7 days overdue, >=24 hours before another review within the same process UUID.
updates: Update age starts when this installation first learns of a newer validated release; another newer release does not postpone it.
Full sync uses the current canonical online-project path; unknown sync age starts at first project observation. Local-only maps receive no sync reminder.
Successful update check has a separate clock; local ready-APK validation does not prove internet success.
actions: Acknowledge the advisory; a ready APK uses the existing manual Install/Later offer.
The reminder does not perform full sync or silently install an APK.
conditions: Only noninteractive focused usable Activity, same captured/current project, and a needed reminder.
Same UUID process session suppresses another display until24h after shown_at; a new process UUID permits another display the same calendar day.
value.saved_state: Availability/observed/check/shown times remain SharedPreferences. Full-project sync has its own canonical path clock; partial/error sync does not replace it. Layout extraction changes none of these keys or clocks.
expectations: Oracle: exactly seven days does not warn, more than seven days does; update/check/project clocks advance only from their own events.
Same process within24h suppresses another advisory; new process can warn again the same day. Local-only/different project cannot reuse the previous project warning.
Complete warning and Install/Later/OK actions remain available with bounded scrolling and unchanged handlers.
unknowns: Process-scoped suppression is weaker than a global once-per-day policy; this release does not change that policy.
Stored sync clock does not certify physical durability or live NGW completion; existing clock-delivery risks remain separate.
Earlier Full passed MaintenanceRemindersNativeTest; extracted-helper regression is pending.
